current_activity: division contains the German garrisons in the Brittany ports (CMH: entered combat 1 January 1945)
notes: Event date: 1 January 1945 (CMH ETO-OB chronology for the 66th Infantry Division: entered combat 1 January 1945; arrived on the Continent 26 December 1944; Wikipedia: the division relieved the 94th Division of control of the Brittany-Loire area on 29 December 1944). Relationship: 12th Army Group assigned (from 27 Dec 44, CMH table). The table entries start on the first row of the unbroken run (convention V-013). Location: a representative point half-way between Lorient and Saint-Nazaire; the sources give no command post for the period.
